note: Concept register only. Everything here is provisional evidence from the Longform prototype; canon (Plans, inventory, Command Catalog, Wiring Matrix) is untouched and adjudicated later.

plan_owner_impacts.evidence: Longform proves an editorial, list-led Settings composition: a persistent text-led domain rail beside one bounded-measure reading column (~76ch even at 2500px), twelve full-width destination rows instead of cards, ruled More/Advanced folds keeping 4-8 rows per heading, and in-flow manager detail sheets that push content instead of overlaying. Deep links (#/home, #/dest, #/manager, #/setting, #/search, #/all, #/copy) ride pm2-route with real Back/Forward.

The rev-2 deep-link probe id system.health.diagnostics-verbosity is absent from the generated 828-row PM2_INVENTORY (only the _shared extension dataset carries it). Longform renders stale/unknown setting deep links as an honest 'Not in this project's settings' surface (raw id shown, recovery links to the domain, search, All Settings, Home); the real probe row system.health.platform-diagnostics lands exactly with focus + locator. Inventory and probe list must be reconciled before canon minting.

Navigation, search selection, copy transaction, and manager actions all route through one dest-object grammar (route/cat/sub/managerId/objectId/tab/settingId plus focus=<rid>); the catalog's cmd.settings.navigate family should accept exactly this payload.

Permissions & FileSafe renders from the shared registry view model only (rules roster, doom-loop form, FileSafe checks); Longform adds no new permission semantics, confirming the headless model is sufficient for a fully different composition.

Provider rosters keep the shared resolver strings verbatim: multi-install selected/shadowed cards, unknown-owner manual-only refusal (Ollama update action renders disabled with the reason and returns an honest refusal), ask-first Codex update, verification-failed rollback history, and the explicit official-source Cursor CLI setup steps with host/environment choices.

Project Hosting & Files, Project Sync & Move, and Full Server Backup appear only as reachable read-only insertion shells naming storage-plan.md as owner, with return contracts rendered verbatim; no backend state was fabricated.

Copy Settings runs as a quiet focused dialog: source, category counts, full preview (add/replace/unchanged/unavailable/conflict with item inspection), credential-by-reference note, restore point, atomic verified apply, receipt with working rollback — walked end-to-end in the c06 verify suite including rollback.

settings_inventory_impacts.note: Stale rev-2 probe id, not one of the 828 generated rows. Longform diagnoses it with an honest not-found surface (never a blank page, never a fabricated row); the current probe row is system.health.platform-diagnostics.
Stress records surface only in All Settings and search, always marked 'Stress fixture', never mixed into domain browsing.

settings_schema_impacts.note: resolveRow's state vocabulary (normal/managed/unavailable/restart-required/reconnect-required/changed-elsewhere/error) rendered cleanly in a single-column editorial row without extra metadata columns; stateNote as an italic line under the row is sufficient at every width.

The two-tier simple/advanced split maps to Longform's ruled folds, but subgroups of ~23 rows still need an editorial cut (first 7 rows, then 'More …'); a curated 'lead' flag per subgroup would remove the arbitrary slice.

schema_event_storage_impacts.note: Only pm.settingsConcepts.fable.concept-06-directory-take-2.* keys are written (shell prefs plus pm2-states persistence). No other storage.
All staged work (manager actions, copy apply/rollback) surfaces PM2.states op payloads verbatim; determinate progress shown only when the payload carries completed/total.

migration_supersession_impacts.note: Longform is another persistent-workspace proof: rail + reading column coexist with the Activity Bar; no floating chip surface anywhere.
legacyScope renders only inside the row Details drawer as impact prose; no Global/Project control exists anywhere in the concept.

slint_port_impacts.note: All Settings windowing (fixed 62px rows, spacer technique) maps directly to a Slint ListView with a row-height model; filters are pure functions over the flat inventory list.
The manager sheet is an ordinary element inserted into the column flow (no overlay, no measured geometry), portable as a conditional child component; tabs are plain state.

Fade-and-rise uses one keyframe with a per-element index variable, capped at 9 steps — equivalent to sequenced opacity/offset animations on a ListView; reduced-motion collapses via the shared kill switches with no JS dependence on transitionend.

test_fixtures.proof: PASS at 1280, 760, 2500 across the default 12-route walk (zero console errors/warnings, no overflow).
18/18 interactive checks: search landing sequence, Back restore, duplicate labels, typo, no-results, toggle/number editing, copy apply+rollback, escape ladder, fold auto-reveal, stress windowing.
